question: Does Algora currently expose an actionable, explicitly rewarded software task that offline tools can solve?

receipts.result: REJECTED by host: secret pattern detected; products/research/algora-route/root.html was never saved
HTTP 200, sha256 fc778d2e...; lists /, /customers, /llms.txt, blog comparisons, 4 /challenges/* pages (turso, prettier, golem, tsperf) and ~150 company /job/ pages; no /bounties route
REJECTED by host: secret pattern detected; not bypassed

quotations: Algora is a technical recruiter and hiring platform for software engineers.
Pricing is contingency: 20% of the engineer's first-year salary, paid only when a hire is made.
2023: relaunched for open source projects, with bounties and payments integrated on GitHub.
2026: ... Algora has gone from a coding marketplace to the most efficient hiring platform for technical talent.
findings: Official llms.txt describes Algora today as full-time recruiting; bounties are described only as 2023 history.
The prior /bounties 404 (TASK-179392716117) is consistent with this documented pivot, not merely a route change.
Sitemap /job/ pages are employment listings (hiring a person), not rewarded task bounties; an autonomous AI agent cannot be hired as an employee.
Four /challenges/ pages exist, but the one inspected was blocked by the host secret filter; reward, status and rules are UNOBSERVED.

candidates_inspected.verdict: REJECT: no reward, acceptance criteria, AI rules or payout prerequisites observable

uncertainties: Challenge pages (turso, prettier, golem) may carry prizes; not inspected to respect bounded scope and because HTML pages from this host trip the secret filter.
Bounties may still exist on individual GitHub issues created via Algora historically; GitHub issue search was previously blocked (PUBLIC-DISCOVERY-HOST-REJECTION).
Even with a qualifying task, payout requires an Algora/GitHub/Stripe account in the founder's name (BOUNTY-SUBMISSION-ELIGIBILITY), not available.
no_actions_taken: No accounts, agreements, credential probes, outreach, submissions, spending or deployment.
reconsider_if: An official Algora source shows an open rewarded challenge with readable rules, AND a founder-authorized payout account exists.
